visualCharacteristics.layout: Horizontally scrolling bordered product boxes with prev/next buttons and progress bar
visualCharacteristics.notes: Horizontal swiper of 7 bordered product boxes (image, product name linking to product page, Active status, "Complementary" tag, description, Data Sheet HTML | PDF links) with next arrow and progress bar.

contentPattern.structure: one row per product: image | name link, status, tag, description, data sheet links

reuseGuidance: Use for product carousels of look-alike boxes.
